description: The agent must: (1) Read SKILL.md to understand the 7-day AI local search optimization workflow. (2) Parse workspace/admin/licenses/business_license.txt to extract the LEGAL registered business name (成都松果餐饮管理有限公司锦江分店 / Chengdu Songguo Hotpot Restaurant), ignoring the informal alias 'Pinecone Hotpot' in the brief. (3) Parse workspace/admin/licenses/business_brief.txt for address (No. 88, Shaocheng Road, Jinjiang District, Chengdu, Sichuan), phone (028-85551234), services, target demographics, and 5 keywords. (4) Generate exactly 7 daily media articles, each with title and 500+ words of content, all embedding the correct legal business name, full address, and phone number. (5) Load workspace/marketing/media_channels.json and apply the three-rule selection logic from SKILL.md: (a) Cover all three geographic tiers (provincial + municipal + local); (b) Select ONLY food/lifestyle/local-consumption media — reject automotive (M03, M12), education (M04), beauty (M07), and fitness (M08) channels as cross-industry; (c) Apply cost-efficiency and choose the cheapest valid channel per tier: M02 (provincial, 650 CNY), M06 (municipal, 420 CNY), M11 (local, 150 CNY). (6) Output everything as optimization_plan.json with keys: 'articles' (list of 7 objects with title+content), 'selected_media' (list of chosen channel objects with their IDs), and any other relevant planning fields.
